The position leads a team of 2 associates and partners across Procurement, Finance, IT, Data, Legal, and the business to keep the Source to Procure engine reliable, scalable, compliant, and value-focused. The successful candidate will finalize and enhance the digital roadmap, establish fit-for-purpose governance, define and communicate decision-enabling KPIs, guide users to preferred suppliers and buying channels, and measure whether each capability is delivering the intended adoption and business outcomes. This leader combines procurement process expertise, digital product ownership, data-driven decision-making, change leadership, and practical execution to help sourcing managers set or reset category strategies using trusted data and actionable insights.​

Job Responsibilities

  • Digital Capability Strategy and Roadmap. Own, finalize, communicate, and continuously refresh the Source to Pay (focus on Source to Procure) digital roadmap. Translate procurement priorities into a sequenced portfolio for e-sourcing, contract lifecycle management, spend analytics, intake and demand management, and e-procurement, with clear outcomes, dependencies, investment needs, and change management. 10%
  • Digital Product Implementation and Sustainment. Lead the implementation, enhancement, integration, release management, and ongoing operational health of Source to Procure platforms. Ensure capabilities are stable, scalable, supported, and embedded in end-to-end processes; proactively manage issues, risks, and improvement backlogs to keep the Source to Procure engine up and running. 10%
  • Governance, Policy, and Process Control. Establish and chair governance for digital procurement capabilities, global procurement policies, workflows, controls, decision rights, minimal data standards, and process ownership. Confirm that policies remain current, practical, globally applicable, and aligned with the Source to Pay operating model, compliance requirements, and delegated authorities. 10%
  • Adoption, Training, and Change Management. Develop and execute role-based implementation, communication, training, and change plans. Build capability among sourcing managers, buyers, approvers, requisitioners, and other end users; monitor sustained usage, address adoption barriers, and reinforce new ways of working through targeted interventions. 10%
  • Performance Management and Value Realization. Define what good and success look like for each digital capability. Establish baselines, targets, benefits, service levels, and adoption measures; publish performance insights and lead corrective actions when outcomes, user experience, compliance, or value realization are below expectations.10%
  • Spend Analytics, Data, and Decision Enablement. Taxonomy stewardship, making sure quality and analytical requirements are fit for purpose, helping procurement teams to make their decisions and helping sourcing managers identify opportunities, evaluate performance, and set or reset category and supplier strategies. 10%
  • Intake, Demand, and Buying Channel Management. Optimize how business demand enters Procurement, is triaged, and is routed to the appropriate fulfillment path. Guide end users to preferred suppliers, catalogs, contracts, and buying channels; reduce unnecessary complexity, off-contract spend, rework, and cycle time while improving user experience and policy compliance.10%
  • Partner with the Invoice to Pay Leader. Work across upstream and downstream processes to evolve Source to Pay as one seamless process. Anticipate cross-process opportunities to improve productivity, remove inefficiencies, and resolve shared challenges. 10%
  • Team Leadership and Capability Building. Lead, coach, and develop two direct reports; establish clear accountability, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans. Build an inclusive, outcome-oriented team that combines procurement process expertise, digital product management, analytics, governance, and change leadership. 10%
  • Continuous Improvement and Innovation. Maintain an external perspective on leading practices, automation, analytics, AI, and market capabilities. Apply structured problem solving to simplify and standardize processes, test improvements, scale proven solutions, and ensure innovation serves a clear business need rather than becoming technology for technology’s sake. 10%

  • Strong operator who balances transformation with the discipline required to keep critical capabilities running.
  • Data-driven decision-maker who challenges assumptions, improves data trust, and converts insights into practical action.
  • Clear communicator who can align executives, sourcing managers, technical teams, suppliers, and end users. “Translator” approach, i.e. facilitator to “convert” technical language into business language and vice-versa.

The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a Community Management Associate to engage online communities, help refine our brand voice, and build a vibrant, Gen Z-focused social media presence for Wikipedia and the Wikimedia Foundation.

Sitting on the Social Team within External Communications, you will bring energy and creativity to how we show up across platforms. From writing engaging comment copy and jumping on real-time cultural moments to surfacing stories from our global volunteer community, you will help connect Wikipedia with next-generation internet audiences.

This is a fast-moving, hands-on role perfect for someone who lives on social media, loves online culture, and is eager to test and learn. Preferred working time zones are UTC -8 to UTC -5 (Mexico, Columbia, Canada and United States)

Ideally You Are:

  • A Digital Culture Native: Plugged into emerging trends and short-form video culture (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) with a natural feel for Gen Z engagement.
  • A Strong Communicator: Experienced in writing social comment copy and adapting brand tone across different platforms.
  • An Organized Framework Builder: Eager to help draft clear community playbooks, response protocols, and engagement guidelines.
  • A Community Connector: Excited to interact directly with followers and surface stories from our global volunteer network.
  • A Data-Aware Learner: Comfortable reviewing basic analytics and social listening insights to refine engagement tactics.

Key Responsibilities

Community Engagement & Copywriting

  • Assist in writing daily social copy, managing comment sections, and executing reactive engagement on trending moments.
  • Support the development and documentation of community management playbooks and brand tone-of-voice guidelines.
  • Help identify, surface, and share inspiring stories from Wikipedia’s global volunteer community.

Trends & Growth

  • Track short-form video trends, platform updates, and emerging formats to recommend fresh engagement opportunities.
  • Support testing of social listening and moderation tools to improve community response time.

Tracking & Operations

  • Monitor channel activity, track audience sentiment, and assist with monthly performance reporting.
  • Participate in creative experimentation to see which copy and engagement styles resonate best.

Skills & Experience

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in social media execution, community management, or digital storytelling.
  • Short-Form Native: Active familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
  • Writing & Moderation: Experience writing social copy, engaging in comment sections, or moderating online channels.
  • Basic Tool Familiarity: Exposure to social management, analytics, or listening tools.
  • Good Judgment: High emotional intelligence to navigate sensitive comments and know when to escalate risks.
  • Global Mindset: Awareness of cross-cultural nuances and working with diverse global audiences.

Qualities That Matter to Us

  • Passion for the Wikimedia mission and free knowledge.
  • Flexibility working with distributed teams across time zones.
  • A collaborative spirit, curiosity, and a real love for internet culture.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

Purdue IT | Research Computing | Remote for the right person

Join Purdue IT in a leadership role supporting world-class research and discovery. As the Senior Manager, Research Solutions Engineering, you will lead a team of experienced research technology professionals responsible for delivering and supporting advanced high-performance computing, storage, networking, and archival solutions for Purdue's research community.

Working closely with the Director of Integrated Cyberinfrastructure and Research Solutions Engineering Leads, you will help guide strategic initiatives, oversee technology planning and infrastructure investments, support day-to-day operations, and represent the team on advisory, policy, and project committees. This role combines technical leadership, staff development, and operational management. If you are passionate about enabling cutting-edge research through technology, developing talented teams, and shaping the future of research computing, we invite you to explore this opportunity.

Why Purdue?

  • Collaborate with talented professionals across a nationally recognized research institution
  • Influence the direction of enterprise-scale research computing services and infrastructure
  • Support and mentor a team dedicated to delivering exceptional research technology solutions

Purdue University’s Rosen Center for Advanced Computing is committed to promoting and advancing all forms of opportunities to create an environment where the uniqueness of individuals is celebrated and persons from all backgrounds can thrive.

Purdue’s Rosen Center for Advanced Computing provides access to leading-edge computational and data storage systems as well as expertise in a broad range of high-performance computing activities. To fulfill our mission, we:

  • provide advanced computational resources and services to support Purdue faculty and staff researchers
  • evaluate, deploy, and support hardware and software for large-scale scientific computing
  • promote the effective use of our research computing systems and application software through training and education, consultation, and documentation
  • contribute to the discovery process through algorithm design and development of effective computing techniques

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related business discipline.
  • At least four (4) years of experience that shows a track record of taking on greater responsibility over time — for example, moving from individual technical work into leading projects, coordinating with other teams, or supervising or mentoring colleagues
    • Experience in developing effective and collaborative partnerships within and across organizations
    • Experience supervising direct reports or strong mentorship experience, including setting expectations, providing guidance, and feedback
  • Consideration will be given to an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred:

  • Experience in using or administering services in relations to large-scale, Linux-based high-performance computing (HPC) clusters or configuring software programs and applications in Linux-based computing environments

Skills Required:

  • Knowledge of advanced computational resources and services to support research, such as HPC, research networks, operations, and data storage systems
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to communicate with faculty, students, colleagues, and leaders
  • Strong Demonstrated ability to successfully lead and manage complex technical projects
  • Ability to:
    • work effectively both individually and as part of a team
    • consult with and provide support for researchers, make presentations, develop and present training material, and develop reports
    • promote team relationship skills and communication

More than 35 years ago, SelectQuote was founded on one core promise: to help our customers protect the people they value most. We pioneered the way consumers shopped for term life insurance, and now, we also help people find home insurance, auto insurance, senior health insurance and more. Our quick and easy process saves consumers both time and money, and today, more than 2 million families trust us to help them with their insurance needs.

But what truly sets us apart is our people, and the opportunities to grow your career with SelectQuote are unmatched.

About the Role

Sales Development Advisor

Job Summary:

SelectQuote is seeking experienced, driven, resilient, and results-oriented sales professionals to join our Qualifications Team as a Sales Development Advisor (SDA).

The SDA is an unlicensed, outbound sales position responsible for contacting prospective customers, generating interest in SelectQuote's products, understanding customer needs, overcoming objections, and transferring qualified prospects to a licensed insurance agent.

This is not a customer service role. This is a high-volume, metrics-driven sales position. Successful candidates must be comfortable making hundreds of outbound calls each day, working from established scripts and processes, handling rejection, and consistently working toward performance goals.

This role provides paid training, a base salary plus bonus opportunity, and a potential career path into a licensed sales agent position. After demonstrating success in the role, SelectQuote will provide opportunities to enter a sales training program and assist with obtaining an insurance license.

Candidates who currently hold an insurance license will not be considered for this position.

After applying, qualified candidates will receive a phone call to complete our pre-screening questionnaire.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Make high-volume outbound calls to prospective customers, with activity of up to 800 calls per day.
  • Generate interest and create meaningful engagement with prospective customers.
  • Quickly establish rapport and communicate confidently and professionally over the phone.

  • Identify customer needs and qualify prospects for transfer to a licensed insurance agent.

  • Handle and overcome objections, stalls, hesitation, and rejection throughout the sales conversation.

  • Confidently redirect conversations and move qualified prospects toward the next step.

  • Follow established sales scripts, processes, and instructions while maintaining a natural and engaging conversation.

  • Meet or exceed monthly transfer, contact-to-transfer, and other performance goals.

  • Accept coaching and demonstrate the ability to apply feedback to improve sales performance.

  • Work effectively with multiple monitors, software applications, and phone systems.

  • Maintain consistent attendance, punctuality, productivity, and performance.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • At least 1 year of telesales, inside sales, phone sales, or comparable sales experience required.

  • Proven ability to work in a high-volume, metrics-driven or commission-based sales environment preferred.

  • Demonstrated success working toward quotas, KPIs, conversion goals, or other measurable sales objectives.

  • Strong objection-handling and closing skills.

  • Confident, energetic, and conversational phone presence.

  • Strong active listening and communication skills.

  • Ability to follow scripts and established sales processes.

  • Ability to accept coaching and implement feedback.

  • Professional and reliable work habits.

  • Consistent employment history and demonstrated commitment to previous roles preferred.

  • Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain significant employment gaps, frequent job changes, or positions not reflected on their resume.

  • Current insurance licenses are not eligible for this position.

Compensation & Career Growth:

  • Paid training.

  • Base salary plus bonus opportunity.

  • Average first-year earnings of approximately $50,000, with top producers earning $80,000+.

  • Potential opportunity to enter SelectQuote's sales training program after six months of successful performance.

  • SelectQuote will support successful associates in pursuing an insurance license and progressing into a licensed sales role.

This Role Is a Good Fit for You If:

  • You have a genuine sales mindset and enjoy influencing customers toward a next step.
  • You are comfortable making a very high volume of outbound calls every day.
  • You don't get discouraged by rejection.
  • You can confidently handle "I'm not interested," "I need to think about it," and other common objections.
  • You enjoy working toward quotas, KPIs, and measurable sales goals.
  • You are comfortable using a sales script and can make it sound natural rather than robotic.
  • You can follow a structured sales process while still actively listening and responding to the customer.
  • You are competitive and motivated by improving your numbers.
  • You can stay engaged and energetic through repetitive, high-volume work.
  • You take coaching seriously and can demonstrate changes based on feedback.
  • You can provide specific examples of your past sales performance and accomplishments.
  • You are looking for a long-term sales career, with the potential to progress into a licensed sales role.
  • You are dependable and prepared to consistently work your assigned schedule.

This Role May Not Be a Good Fit for You If:

  • You are primarily looking for a customer service position.

  • You are primarily interested in working from home for flexibility rather than pursuing a sales career.

  • You dislike scripted sales environments or are unwilling to follow established sales processes.

  • You prefer conversations without sales goals, quotas, or performance expectations.

  • You become uncomfortable when customers object, hesitate, or say no.

  • You have difficulty redirecting a conversation or moving a prospect toward the next step.

  • You struggle to maintain energy and engagement during repetitive phone interactions.

  • You are uncomfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

  • You prefer not to be coached or change your approach based on feedback.

  • You cannot provide specific examples of your sales accomplishments or performance.

  • You are unable to commit consistently to a set schedule, attendance expectations, and the demands of a full-time sales position.

Work-From-Home Requirements:

This is a full-time W-2 work-from-home position with an assigned schedule.

Employees must:

  • Be punctual and consistently adhere to their assigned schedule and attendance requirements.

  • Have a quiet, dedicated workspace free from distractions.

  • Have reliable high-speed internet with minimum speeds of 20 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload through a hardwired connection.

  • Be able to remain fully engaged and available throughout scheduled work hours.

  • Be willing to work overtime, weekends, or schedule variations when business needs require it.

Empowerment — We embrace a changing environment.

Teamwork — We help, support, and celebrate each other.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, qualifications, or requirements.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Savvital is a forward-thinking organization that provides diversified services to small and medium-sized businesses in the international market to enable them to build their future while benefiting from our customized solutions. Our team of educated experts are motivated individuals excited to handle tasks that can bring capacity to your workday. Our Mission is to provide an affordable solution to growing companies through strategic task delegation. We envision creating an eco-system that resonates with the human touch every business needs.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Savvital is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Insurance Associate to support the day-to-day operations of a US-based insurance agency. This role combines commercial insurance quoting, policy renewals, health insurance administration, and office support, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.

The ideal candidate will have experience supporting US insurance agencies, strong organizational skills, and the ability to take ownership of policy renewals, client communication, and administrative processes.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Commercial Quoting & Market Submissions
  • Review inbound prospect files (payroll, revenue, employee counts, operations)
  • Compile and submit E&O, D&O, and Cyber Liability applications
  • Complete ACORD applications for Workers' Comp and general commercial P&C
  • Upload underwriting packets to carrier portals or underwriters directly; daily status follow up
  • Commercial P&C & Surplus Lines Renewals
  • Monitor QQCatalyst alert dashboard for accounts expiring in 60 to 90 days
  • Order/review loss runs, verify payroll, revenue, and property values
  • Coordinate with wholesale/surplus lines brokers on hard to place risks; gather E&S documentation and fraud statements
  • Group & Personal Health Insurance
  • Manage and update employee censuses for group health prospects and renewals
  • Run health insurance quote comparisons across carrier portals
  • Track open enrollment timelines and log plan/subsidy changes
  • Daily Office & Client Administration
  • Answer office phone calls
  • Collect new client information and set up client files
  • Check new forms for missing details
  • Send electronic welcome packets
  • Help broker prepare for client meetings
  • Renewal Paperwork & Follow Up
  • Track renewal dates, send renewal notices
  • Collect updated client details, file updated forms
  • Follow up on pending documents
  • System & Client Records
  • Maintain QQCatalyst data hygiene (profiles, documents, effective dates, communication logs)
  • Send automated renewal reminders, chase missing underwriting info
  • Assist with renewal payment collection and EFT/ACH setup

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years supporting a US based independent insurance agency, with hands on commercial quoting and renewal experience
  • Vertafore QQCatalyst proficiency required
  • Experience with major P&C, professional liability, and health carrier portals strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of ACORD forms, loss runs, E&S compliance, cyber/professional supplements, and health census data

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base Salary: Market Competitive.

Allowances: Internet, Electricity, and Wellbeing.

Health: Medical Insurance.

Growth: Performance-based bonuses, annual increments, and company-wide success bonuses.

      <title>Dremio: Software Engineer - Query Execution</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Portugal - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong><br>Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, building the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.</p>
<p>As a Software Engineer, you’ll work with experienced engineers to build, test, and support well-scoped improvements to the execution engine. You’ll learn how Dremio’s query runtime works while contributing to areas such as query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, scheduling, and performance.<br><br><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build and support execution-engine components: Implement, test, debug, and maintain well-defined changes to query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, and resource management.</li>
<li>Develop reliable software: Write clear, maintainable Java code; add unit and integration tests; and follow established engineering practices for code review, testing, and documentation.</li>
<li>Investigate issues: Help diagnose query correctness, reliability, and performance issues using query profiles, logs, telemetry, benchmarks, and production data.</li>
<li>Learn runtime and performance fundamentals: Build familiarity with vectorized processing, concurrency, memory usage, parallelism, data exchange, and disk spilling.</li>
<li>Collaborate with the team: Work closely with senior engineers and partner teams to understand requirements, break work into manageable tasks, and deliver incremental improvements.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation, while validating results through testing, review, and sound engineering judgment.</li>
<li>Grow your engineering skills: Participate actively in design discussions and code reviews, seek feedback, and steadily take on broader technical responsibility.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Software engineering foundation: Up to two years of professional software development experience, or equivalent experience through internships, coursework, or substantial personal projects.</li>
<li>Programming skills: Proficiency in Java or another object-oriented programming language; willingness to learn and work in a large Java codebase.</li>
<li>Computer science fundamentals: Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and basic concurrency concepts.</li>
<li>Problem-solving ability: Able to work through well-defined technical problems, ask good questions, and apply feedback to reach a solution.</li>
<li>Quality mindset: Commitment to writing tested, maintainable code and learning established development, testing, and review practices.</li>
<li>Communication and collaboration: Able to communicate progress, surface blockers early, and work effectively with teammates.</li>
<li>Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>Exposure to database internals, query processing, distributed systems, or large-scale data processing.</li>
<li>Familiarity with performance-oriented software concepts such as profiling, memory management, concurrency, or vectorized processing.</li>
<li>Experience with C++, Apache Arrow, Parquet, Apache Iceberg, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.</li>
<li>Contributions to open-source projects.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>What we value&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.</span></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click </span></em><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CB96QFmOX-bFy48YFOe2GO5lmdawOpKKBj8DpTgsuNg/edit?usp=sharing"><em><span>here</span></em></a><em><span> to review the privacy notice.&nbsp;</span></em></p>
<h3><strong>Important Security Notice for Candidates</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement&nbsp;<a href="https://www.dremio.com/blog/stay-alert-for-fraudulent-recruitment-attempts-that-falsely-claim-association-with-dremio/">here</a>.</span></p>
<p><em>Dremio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.</em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/dremio-software-engineer-query-execution">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/dremio-software-engineer-query-execution</a></p>
</description>

<p>Sounds good for you? Apply now and join the <a href="https://lemon.io/for-developers/?utm_source=weworkremotely&amp;utm_medium=job_ad&amp;utm_campaign=supply_en_angular_net/php/node_oct_2026_job_ad">Lemon.io</a> community!</p>

      <title>PagerDuty: Senior Director, Field Enablement</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (USA - San Francisco, CA)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></h2>
<p>PagerDuty is seeking a <strong>Sr. Director, Field Enablement</strong> to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As Sr. Director of&nbsp; Field Enablement, you will lead a team of enablement professionals supporting our sales, customer success, and partnership organizations.&nbsp;</p>
<p>You will build and scale our global enablement function to ensure our customer-facing teams are equipped to sell and support our diversifying product portfolio as we enter our next phase of growth. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the enablement strategy for a high-growth SaaS company and directly improve teams' capabilities and productivity worldwide. The ideal candidate is a strategic, seasoned enablement leader passionate about gathering customer feedback and competitive intelligence to develop programs that drive sales excellence and business results.</p>
<h2><strong>ABOUT PAGERDUTY</strong></h2>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Develop, execute, optimize, and assess enablement programs in partnership with sales and customer success leadership, determining priorities and success metrics with key stakeholders</li>
<li>Gather and share insights from customers, competitors, and the market to enable the positioning of PagerDuty’s value proposition to the market</li>
<li>Drive the creation of learning programs and events that align with overall sales and company strategy, enhancing team capabilities, productivity, and high-level selling skills</li>
<li>Build and maintain an enablement delivery platform that provides scalable, measurable content and learning resources to sales, customer success, and partnership teams</li>
<li>Collaborate with marketing and product marketing to develop highly effective and repeatable sales messaging, selling tools, and collateral that enable consistent execution</li>
<li>Design and maintain an end-to-end sales onboarding program in collaboration with HR that certifies new hires on company strategy, product messaging, and sales processes</li>
<li>Develop and lead the everboarding process for the sales team to ensure the continued development of required behaviors and skills to successfully operate a consumption driven business</li>
<li>Build out and scale enablement support functions for Customer Success and Partnerships organizations</li>
<li>Communicate the enablement strategy, roadmap, and KPIs to stakeholders across all global organizations</li>
<li>Develop and maintain a library of sales enablement resources, including sales playbooks, battle cards, product collateral, content library, and competitive intelligence</li>
<li>Drive adoption and utilization of sales enablement tools such as MindTickle and Highspot</li>
<li>Partner with the sales systems team to drive adoption and utilization of sales tools such as Clari, Salesloft, Salesforce, and others</li>
<li>Conduct regular assessments and audits of sales processes and identify areas for improvement and optimization.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Set key metrics to assess the impact of sales enablement efforts on sales performance</li>
<li>Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in sales enablement</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA is a plus</li>
<li>10+ years of sales enablement experience or a combination of sales / post sales, sales training, and enablement roles</li>
<li>5+ years of management experience leading and developing enablement teams</li>
<li>Proven track record of building and delivering innovative, strategic sales enablement programs, including training, onboarding, certifications, and sales events</li>
<li>Experience implementing and maintaining content management platforms such as Highspot or Seismic</li>
<li>3+ years of experience in high-velocity, high-growth startup environments, preferably in the SaaS space, or equivalent degree or experience</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Strong understanding of sales methodologies such as Force Management, MEDDIC and forecasting best practices</li>
<li>Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively train and influence sales professionals at all levels</li>
<li>Experience with Sales Operations and <a href="http://salesforce.com">Salesforce.com</a></li>
<li>Proficiency in using sales enablement tools, CRM systems, and content management platforms. Preferred platforms include Salesforce, Seismic, CRM Analytics, and more</li>
<li>Analytical mindset with the ability to provide actionable insights</li>
<li>Knowledge of Sales Manager training and sales coaching, particularly for Enterprise sales</li>
<li>Strong program and project management skills with the ability to maintain calendars of ongoing training, business reviews, and field communications</li>
<li>Detail and results-oriented with the ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on execution</li>
<li>Collaborative and team-oriented approach with the ability to work cross-functionally</li>
<li>Self-motivated and results-driven with a passion for driving sales excellence</li>
<li>Excel in creating and curating sales collateral, playbooks, training modules, and other resources to support the sales team</li>
<li>Have a track record of driving sales enablement initiatives across different regions and markets, understanding cultural nuances and local sales practices</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>The base salary range for this position is 180,000 - 303,600 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.</p>
<p>Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.</p>
<p>Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Hesitant to apply?</strong></p>
<p>We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/jobalerts">job alerts</a>!</p>
<p><strong>Where we work</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/locations">offices</a> in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we <strong>cannot</strong> employ candidates residing in:</p>
<p><strong>Location restrictions: </strong><strong><br></strong><strong>Australia:</strong> Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia<br><strong>Canada:</strong> Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon<br><strong>United States:</strong> Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming<br><em>Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.</em></p>
<p><strong>How we work</strong></p>
<p><a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/#values">Our values</a> guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.</p>
<p>People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.</p>
<p><strong>What we offer</strong></p>
<p>As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/global-benefits">benefits site</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Your package may include:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive salary</li>
<li>Comprehensive benefits package&nbsp;</li>
<li>Flexible work arrangements</li>
<li>Company equity*</li>
<li>ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*</li>
<li>Retirement or pension plan*</li>
<li>Generous paid vacation time</li>
<li>Paid holidays and sick leave</li>
<li>Dutonian Wellness Days &amp; HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO</li>
<li>Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*</li>
<li>Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year</li>
<li>Company-wide hack weeks</li>
<li>Mental wellness programs</li>
</ul>
<p>*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure</p>
<p><strong>About PagerDuty</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management.       <title>Webflow: Senior Infrastructure Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Argentina Remote
</p>

<p>Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.</p>
<h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2>
<p>We’re looking for a <strong>S</strong><strong>enior Infrastructure Engineer </strong>to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.</p>
<ul>
<li>Location: Remote-first (Argentina)</li>
<li>Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)</li>
<li>Application Information:
<ul>
<li>Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled</li>
<li>This posting is for a new position.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>As an <strong>Senior Infrastructure Engineer</strong> you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.</li>
<li>Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.</li>
<li>Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.</li>
<li>Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate,&nbsp; improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.</li>
<li>Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.</li>
<li>Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.</li>
</ul>
<h2>About you&nbsp;</h2>
<p>You’ll thrive as a <strong>Senior Infrastructure Engineer</strong>&nbsp;if you:</p>
<ul>
<li>Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.</li>
<li>Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.</li>
<li>Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.</li>
<li>Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.</li>
<li>Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.</li>
<li>Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.</li>
</ul>
<p>It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:</p>
<ul>
<li>Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.</li>
<li>Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana</li>
<li>Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.</li>
<li>Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.</li>
</ul>
<p>You Are:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaborative</strong>: You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic thinker</strong>: You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity</strong>: You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.</li>
</ul>
<p>If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still <strong>seriously consider applying</strong>. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.</p>
<h3><strong>Our Core Behaviors:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Build lasting customer trust.</strong> We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.</li>
<li><strong>Win together.</strong> We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.</li>
<li><strong>Reinvent ourselves. </strong>We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.</li>
<li><strong>Own it all the way. </strong>We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Ownership in what you help build.</strong> Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.</li>
<li><strong>Health coverage that actually covers you.</strong> Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.</li>
<li><strong>Support for every stage of family life</strong>. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.</li>
<li><strong>Time off that’s actually off. </strong>Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.</li>
<li><strong>Wellness for the whole you. </strong>Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.</li>
<li><strong>Invest in your future. </strong>A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Monthly stipends that flex with your life.</strong> Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.</li>
<li><strong>Bonus for building together. </strong>All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.</em></p>
<h3><strong>Remote, together</strong></h3>
<p>At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are <a href="https://webflow.com/diversity-equity-inclusion">committed</a> to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.</p>
<h3><strong>Stay connected</strong></h3>
<p>Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our <a href="https://webflow.com/blog">Webflow Blog</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/webflow-inc-/">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/webflow">X (Twitter)</a>, and/or <a href="https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Webflow-Reviews-E890506.htm">Glassdoor</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>Please note:</strong></h3>
<p><em>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.</em></p>
<p><em>To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.</em></p>
<p><em>If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.</em></p>
<p><em>For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review </em><a href="https://webflow.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice"><em>Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice</em></a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

      <title>Wrike: Director, Global GTM Strategy & Operations</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div>Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Our vision:&nbsp; </strong>A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div></div><h3>About the Role:</h3>
<p>You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. Collaborative work management is a $14B category growing at 15% a year, and the enterprise competitive set is consolidating fast. Wrike is hiring a Director of Go-To-Market Operations to lead our global GTM Operations team across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.</p>
<p>You will own Wrike’s revenue planning and operational architecture end-to-end driving annual planning, quota setting, territory management, and cross-functional alignment across our global revenue engine.</p>
<p>Reporting directly to GTM leadership, you will serve as a strategic co-pilot to executive leaders while leading a hands-on global team of 6–15 operations partners and analysts.</p>
<p>This is an action-oriented leadership role for an operational "athlete'' - someone equally comfortable steering C-level strategic decisions, designing enterprise sales workflows, coaching an international team across time zones, and diving deep into the details of compensation plans or GTM forecasting.</p>
<h3>Your Impact:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Global Team Leadership: Build, scale, and mentor a global GTM Operations team (15 team members, including embedded business partners and visualization analysts across diverse time zones), fostering a high-performance, team-first culture.</li>
<li>Annual Planning &amp; Execution: Lead annual planning, quota allocation, capacity modeling, and territory design across Sales, CS, and Marketing teams.</li>
<li>Retention &amp; Growth PMO: Partner with executive leadership to program manage company-wide objectives focused on gross/net retention, bookings, and customer lifecycle optimization.</li>
<li>Executive Facilitation: Lead recurring operational cadences with executive stakeholders (Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, Legal) to eliminate friction and accelerate deal velocity.</li>
<li>Commercial Support &amp; Governance: Oversee non-customer-facing commercial execution, coordinating with Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk to streamline order processing and contracting workflows.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Your Qualifications:</h3>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of progressive experience in Business Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations within B2B SaaS.</li>
<li>Proven People Leadership: Direct experience managing and developing global operational teams (6+ direct/indirect reports) across international time zones.</li>
<li>Core GTM Mechanics: Expertise in SaaS unit economics, quota setting, territory planning, retention/bookings metrics, and annual planning processes.</li>
<li>Execution Track Record: High proficiency operating as an executive-level partner to Sales, Marketing, and CS leadership without needing a massive administrative layer.</li>
<li>Location Preference: East Coast U.S. preferred (ability to align with global time zones and executive leadership).</li>
</ul>
<h3>Standout Qualities:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Core Traits: High curiosity (constantly seeking better ways to execute), unyielding commitment to follow-through, and rigorous attention to detail.</li>
<li>Sales Methodology: Familiarity with enterprise value selling frameworks (e.g., Force Management's Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, or Challenger).</li>
<li>Target Background: Experience operating in high-growth, execution-oriented B2B SaaS environments</li>
</ul>
<p>Team Dynamics: You will partner closely with executive leadership and lead a global team of GTM business partners and data visualization specialists. Your team acts as the central nerve center connecting field execution with executive strategy.</p>
<p>Our Work Style: We run Wrike on Wrike. You will use our collaborative work management platform daily to run annual planning, manage operational portfolios, and track team execution. We value intellectual curiosity, data-backed decision-making, and swift cross-functional execution.</p>
<h3><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Flexible Time Off (FTO)</li>
<li>Company 401(k) Match</li>
<li>Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity&nbsp;</li>
<li>2 Volunteer Days</li>
<li>Health (medical, dental &amp; vision) Insurance (EEs + Dependents)</li>
<li>Disability (STD, LTD) &amp; Life Insurance Plans (2x Salary, Capped)</li>
<li>Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly)</li>
<li>$500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend</li>
</ul>
<p>Your recruitment buddy will be&nbsp;<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/azizatalhi/"><span class="s1">Aziza Talhi</span></a>, Senior Recruiter.</p>
<p>&nbsp;#LI-AT1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The range below reflects the total on-target earnings (including base salary and performance-based bonus potential) for this full-time position and applies to all U.S. locations, excluding benefits and other incentives. The final offer within this range will consider factors such as the role, seniority level, geographic location, and employment contract type. An individual’s work location, unique skills, experience, and relevant educational background will also influence the final offer. For tailored compensation details based on your preferred location, please discuss with your recruiter during the hiring process.</em></p></div><div class="title">Total compensation pay range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$180,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$205,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Who Is Wrike and Our Culture</strong></h3>
<div>We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div><strong>Hybrid work mode</strong></div>
<div><br>
<div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h4><strong>Our persona&nbsp;</strong></h4>
<div><strong>&nbsp; Smart:</strong> We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.</div>
<div><strong>&nbsp; Dedicated: </strong>We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!</div>
<div><strong>&nbsp; Approachable:</strong> We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.&nbsp;</div>
<h4><strong>Our culture and Values&nbsp;</strong></h4>
<p><strong> Customer-Focused</strong></p>
<p><strong>We care about our customers. </strong>We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.</p>
<p><strong> Collaborative</strong></p>
<p><strong>We work as one and win together, </strong>each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.</p>
<p><strong> Creative</strong></p>
<p><strong>We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. </strong>It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong> Committed</strong></p>
<p><strong>We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, </strong>by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.</p>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div>Check out our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/wrike/life/3fd588bf-73e8-47be-9b0a-1933d404ea88/">LinkedIn Life Page</a>, <a href="https://www.wrike.com/wrike-company-culture/">Company culture page</a>, <a href="https://www.instagram.com/wriketeam">Instagram</a>, <a href="https://www.wrike.com/wrike-engineering/">Wrike Engineering Team</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://medium.com/wriketechclub">Medium</a>, <a href="https://www.meetup.com/WrikeTechClub/?_cookie-check=wtgfN9ARYGPSGd3e">Meetup.com</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/wriketechclub">Youtube</a> for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.&nbsp;</div>
</div>

      <title>Stripe: Abuse Research Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote from the US
</p>

<h2>Who we are</h2>
<h3>About Stripe</h3>
<p><span>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p>
<h3>About the team</h3>
<p>Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<p>As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. &nbsp;Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. &nbsp;Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.</p>
<h3>Responsibilities</h3>
<ul>
<li>Proactive Threat Hunting &amp; Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.</li>
<li>FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Cross-Functional Advisories &amp; Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic Testing &amp; Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls. &nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<p><span>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p>
<h3>Minimum requirements</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).&nbsp;</li>
<li>Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&amp;CK.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).</li>
</ul>

</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)
</p>

<h3><strong>Commercial Data Scientist</strong></h3>
<p>Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<p><br><em>This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S.</em></p>
<p><strong>As a Commercial Data Scientist</strong>, you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.</li>
<li>Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights &amp; Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.</li>
<li>Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.</li>
<li>Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.</li>
<li>Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<p><strong>As an organization we value diversity - </strong>in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaboration</strong>—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.</li>
<li><strong>Passion for Data</strong>—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.</li>
<li><strong>Reliability</strong> – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.</li>
<li><strong>Curiosity</strong> – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.</li>
<li><strong>Respect</strong> – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About you:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>At least <strong>4 years</strong> of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.</li>
<li>Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques</li>
<li>Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li>
<li>Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.</li>
<li>Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.</li>
<li>Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.</li>
<li>Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Fun</strong> <strong>Facts About the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.</li>
<li>Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.</li>
<li>The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.</li>
<li>We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.</p>
<p>Our total compensation package may include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Base salary</li>
<li>Equity (where applicable)</li>
<li>Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<p>In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li>
<li>401(k) with company match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off and company holidays</li>
<li>Paid parental leave</li>
<li>Professional development and learning opportunities</li>
<li>Wellness and mental health resources</li>
<li>Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></p>
<p>At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make a real impact.</strong> Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.</li>
<li><strong>Work with exceptional teammates.</strong> Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.</li>
<li><strong>Enjoy flexibility and trust.</strong> We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.</li>
<li><strong>Grow your career.</strong> Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.</li>
<li><strong>Bring your authentic self.</strong> We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Our Hiring Process &amp; AI Tools</strong></p>
<p>Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></p>
<p><em>Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p>
<p><em>If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.</em></p>
